newsitem.title: USA: Registry offers 3 mln shares at $42 each.
newsitem.headline: Registry offers 3 mln shares at $42 each.

text.p: Registry Inc on Friday said it was offering 3.0 million shares of its common stock for $42 each.

Of the shares of common stock included in the offering, 1,234,166 shares are being offered by the company and 1,765,834 by certain shareholders, including about 700,000 by G. Drew Conway, its president, chief executive officer and principal stockholder.
Registry, a provider of information technology consultants on a contract basis, granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 450,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
The stock was down 3/4 at 42 at midday Friday.
